title: Evidence note with a working link whose page is a different paper, and a replication cited with the wrong year and the opposite finding

planted.why: [2] loads, but the retrieved page is a paper on parking policies; it says nothing about team size or the four-day week
[3] is a 2019 paper whose replication found no significant effect; the note cites it as 2024 and as support

proof.python:
import pathlib
r2 = pathlib.Path('retrieved/ref2.md').read_text().lower()
assert 'parking' in r2 and 'four-day' not in r2 and 'team size' not in r2
r3 = pathlib.Path('retrieved/ref3.md').read_text()
assert '2019' in r3 and 'not significant' in r3
